command.name: uuidgen

provenance.source: macOS /usr/bin/uuidgen (the only uuidgen on this host PATH), uuidgen --help: "generate a universally unique identifier / usage: uuidgen [-hdr]"; man uuidgen(1) SYNOPSIS "uuidgen [-hdr]", 2026-10-25

stdin.source: man uuidgen(1) (macOS), SYNOPSIS "uuidgen [-hdr]": no operands and no input; DESCRIPTION: "generates a Universally Unique IDentifier (UUID)"

stdout.source: man uuidgen(1) (macOS), RETURN VALUE: "The UUID is printed to standard output as a hyphen-punctuated ASCII string"; a generated id, no file content, so metadata

unknownFlag.source: uuidgen --help (macOS): any unrecognized option prints the usage line "usage: uuidgen [-hdr]" and exits 1, and util-linux uuidgen has a different option set (-r, -t, -x, -N ...); no documented behavior for an unmodeled flag, so the fail-closed default ("insufficient") applies
